overview: Top-down (LL, recursive descent, predictive) vs bottom-up (shift-reduce, LR, LALR, SLR); parse tables, conflicts, handles, conversion to LL(1).
coreConcept: Top-down leftmost derivation banata hai; bottom-up rightmost derivation ka reverse (reductions).
hinglishExplanation: LL(1) ke liye grammar me left recursion aur common prefix nahi hone chahiye (dono hatana zaroori). Bottom-up parsers me canonical LR sabse powerful (LR(1) > LALR > SLR). LALR merging reduce-reduce conflicts la sakti hai, shift-reduce nahi.
formalDefinition: Top-down leftmost derivation banata hai; bottom-up rightmost derivation ka reverse (reductions).
importantProperties: Bottom-up: operator precedence, shift-reduce, LR, SLR, LALR.
LL(1) conversion: left recursion + left factoring dono.
Handle = right-sentential form ka reducible substring.
LALR merging: reduce-reduce conflict aa sakta hai, shift-reduce nahi.
Predictive table entry M[A,a]: FIRST/FOLLOW se.
Top-down leftmost derivation; bottom-up reverse rightmost.
commonPitfalls: Left recursion hatana hi kaafi maan lena.
